title: Lightsabers (medium)
statementMd:
There is unrest in the Galactic Senate. Several thousand solar systems have declared their intentions to leave the Republic. Master Heidi needs to select the Jedi Knights who will go on peacekeeping missions throughout the galaxy. It is well-known that the success of any peacekeeping mission depends on the colors of the lightsabers of the Jedi who will go on that mission.

Heidi has $*n*$ Jedi Knights standing in front of her, each one with a lightsaber of one of $*m*$ possible colors. She knows that for the mission to be the most effective, she needs to select some contiguous interval of knights such that there are exactly $*k*_{1}$ knights with lightsabers of the first color, $*k*_{2}$ knights with lightsabers of the second color, $...$, $*k*_{*m*}$ knights with lightsabers of the $*m*$-th color.

However, since the last time, she has learned that it is not always possible to select such an interval. Therefore, she decided to ask some Jedi Knights to go on an indefinite unpaid vacation leave near certain pits on Tatooine, if you know what I mean. Help Heidi decide what is the minimum number of Jedi Knights that need to be let go before she is able to select the desired interval from the subsequence of remaining knights.

## Input

The first line of the input contains $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 2·10^{5}$) and $*m*$ ($1 ≤ *m* ≤ *n*$). The second line contains $*n*$ integers in the range ${1, 2, ..., *m*}$ representing colors of the lightsabers of the subsequent Jedi Knights. The third line contains $*m*$ integers $*k*_{1}, *k*_{2}, ..., *k*_{*m*}$ (with ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/028ad21fa922d9cfdf096d658a7e651e74feddcf.png)) – the desired counts of Jedi Knights with lightsabers of each color from $1$ to $*m*$.

## Output

Output one number: the minimum number of Jedi Knights that need to be removed from the sequence so that, in what remains, there is an interval with the prescribed counts of lightsaber colors. If this is not possible, output $- 1$.
statementZhMd:
银河议会中发生了动乱。数千个星系已经宣布打算脱离共和国。Heidi 大师需要挑选出将前往银河系各地执行维和任务的绝地武士。众所周知，任何维和任务能否成功，取决于执行任务的绝地武士所持光剑的颜色。

Heidi 面前站着 $*n*$ 名绝地武士，每个人都持有 $*m*$ 种可能颜色中的一种光剑。她知道，为了使任务最有效，她需要选择一段连续的武士区间，使其中恰好有 $*k*_{1}$ 名武士持有第一种颜色的光剑，$*k*_{2}$ 名武士持有第二种颜色的光剑，$...$，以及 $*k*_{*m*}$ 名武士持有第 $*m*$ 种颜色的光剑。

然而，自上次以来，她了解到并不总能选择出这样的区间。因此，她决定请一些绝地武士前往塔图因附近的某些深坑，进行无限期且无薪的休假——你懂我的意思。请帮助 Heidi 求出：在她能够从剩余武士组成的序列中选择出所需区间之前，最少需要让多少名绝地武士离开。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 2·10^{5}$）和 $*m*$（$1 ≤ *m* ≤ *n*$）。第二行包含 $*n*$ 个整数，每个整数的范围为 ${1, 2, ..., *m*}$，表示后续绝地武士所持光剑的颜色。第三行包含 $*m*$ 个整数 $*k*_{1}, *k*_{2}, ..., *k*_{*m*}$（其中 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/028ad21fa922d9cfdf096d658a7e651e74feddcf.png)），表示从第 $1$ 种颜色到第 $*m*$ 种颜色的光剑所需的绝地武士数量。

## 输出格式

输出一个数：从序列中移除的绝地武士的最少数量，使得剩余序列中存在一个区间，其中各颜色光剑的数量符合给定要求。如果无法做到，输出 $- 1$。
